units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 1:1:20">Y. Yoma I, 38ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>אנו פִּעְפַּעְנוּ את הכתלים</he> we (through our sins) have smashed the walls (with ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 137:7">Ps. CXXXVII, 7</cite>); Midr. Till. to Ps. l. c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:19">Y. Sabb. VII, 9ᵈ</cite> sq. <he>המְפַעְפֵּעַ גושים</he> he that crushes clods.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 1:2:9">Y. Orl. I, 61ᵃ</cite> <he>השרשים מְפַעְפְּעִין אותו</he> the roots pierce it (the pot).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 10a:12">B. Bath. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>ברזל קשה אור מְפַעְפְּעוֹ</he> iron is hard, fire penetrates it; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:26:2">Koh. R. to VII, 26</cite> <he>והאש מְפַעְפַּעְתּוֹ</he>.
<cite ref="Chullin 105a:17">Ḥull. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>החמין מפעפעין את הידים וכ׳</he> hot water enters into the skin of the hands, but does not wash away the fatty substance.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4:12">Lam. R. to IV, 9</cite> <he>היה אותו הריח מפעפע בהם וכ׳</he> the flavor permeated them (creating a morbid appetite), and they died.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16">Lev. R. s. 16</cite>, v. <cite ref="P00742"><he>עֶכֶן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:15">Y. Snh. X, 28ᵈ</cite> top <he>והיה ריחו מפעפע</he> and the flavor of wine spread.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:1:10">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵇ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 6:4">Ruth R. to III, 13</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:8">Koh. R. to VII, 8</cite>, v. <cite ref="K01244"><he>כֶּרֶס</he></cite>; a. e.
